I added a 0.25s `time.sleep` after each request in `tests/test_payments.py`, which holds the loop to about 4 requests per second, under the sandbox's 5 per second limit. I haven't run the test, so I haven't confirmed that the CI flake is gone.

The delay is a `CALL_DELAY_S` constant at the top of the file. The test loop makes 4 calls, so the sleeps add about one second to the run.

I also saved the rate limit as a hazard memory in EngramDB, so later sessions know that new sandbox tests need the same pacing.
